title: pinus luchuensis subsp. hwangshanensis
intro: Pinus luchuensis subsp. hwangshanensis, commonly known as Hwangshan White Pine, is a subspecies of evergreen tree in the Pinaceae family native to China. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and enhancing immune function. The therapeutic actions of Hwangshan White Pine include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
